errors.evidence: The blue solid line, representing Character Attention input, starts at a value of approximately 0.1 at layer 0, not 0.2.

errors.text_span: and then gradually declines to around 0.7 at layer 30.
errors.evidence: This description of the Character Attention input (blue solid line) is an over-generalization that misses a key feature. The line does not decline gradually; it drops sharply to a minimum of around 0.25 near layer 13 before rising again.
The peak for the Character MLP input (blue dashed line) occurs around layer 3 or 4, not at layer 5.
The value for the Character MLP input (blue dashed line) at layer 30 is approximately 0.8, not 0.85.

errors.text_span: and then fluctuates between 0.6 and 0.8 until layer 30.
errors.evidence: This description of the Wiki Attention input (red solid line) is a significant over-generalization. It completely misses the dramatic dip to a minimum value of approximately 0.38 around layer 14, which is far below the stated 0.6 lower bound.
The peak for the Wiki MLP input (red dashed line) is closer to 0.88, not 0.9.

errors.text_span: This observation supports the decision to use the last MLP layer input as the embedding in the main experiments of MEGa.
